items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.0, implementations of this method should load ApplicationContextFailureProcessor implementations via the SpringFactoriesLoader mechanism, catch any exception thrown by the ContextLoader, and delegate to each of the configured failure processors to process the context load failure if the exception is an instance of ContextLoadException.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.0 起，此方法的实现应通过SpringFactoriesLoader机制加载ApplicationContextFailureProcessor实现，捕获由ContextLoader抛出的任何异常，并在该异常是ContextLoadException的实例时，委托给每个配置的故障处理器以处理上下文加载失败。

items.source: Note: CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate does not extend the ContextLoader or SmartContextLoader interface.
items.translation: 注意：CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate 不继承ContextLoader或SmartContextLoader接口。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.1, implementations of this method are encouraged to support the failure threshold feature. Specifically, if repeated attempts are made to load an application context and that application context consistently fails to load — for example, due to a configuration error that prevents the context from successfully loading — this method should preemptively throw an IllegalStateException if the configured failure threshold has been exceeded. Note that the ContextCache provides support for tracking and incrementing the failure count for a given context cache key.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，鼓励此方法的实现支持失败阈值功能。具体而言，如果多次尝试加载应用程序上下文且该上下文始终无法加载（例如，由于配置错误导致上下文无法成功加载），则当配置的失败阈值被超过时，此方法应主动抛出IllegalStateException。请注意，ContextCache提供了跟踪和增加给定上下文缓存键的失败次数的支持。

items.source: Implementations of this method must not load the application context as a side effect. In addition, implementations of this method should not log the cache statistics via ContextCache.logStatistics().
items.translation: 此方法的实现不得将应用程序上下文作为副作用加载。此外，此方法的实现不应通过ContextCache.logStatistics()记录缓存统计信息。

items.source: The default implementation of this method always returns false. Custom CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate implementations are therefore highly encouraged to override this method with a more meaningful implementation. Note that the standard CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate implementation in Spring overrides this method appropriately.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现始终返回 `false`。因此，强烈建议自定义的 `CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate` 实现覆盖此方法，以提供更具有意义的实现。请注意，Spring 中的标准 `CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate` 实现已适当地覆盖了此方法。

items.source: The semantics of the supplied HierarchyMode must be honored when removing the context from the cache. See the Javadoc for DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode for details.
items.translation: 移除缓存中的上下文时，必须遵守提供的 `HierarchyMode` 的语义。有关详细信息，请参阅 DirtiesContext.HierarchyMode 的 Javadoc。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, this SPI includes optional support for registering and unregistering context usage.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，此 SPI 包含用于注册和注销上下文使用的可选支持。

items.source: May alternatively be configured via the SpringProperties mechanism.
items.translation: 也可以通过 SpringProperties 机制进行配置。

items.source: Implementations of CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate are not required to support this feature. Consult the documentation of the corresponding implementation for details. Note, however, that the standard CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate implementation in Spring supports this feature.
items.translation: `CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate` 的实现并不要求支持此功能。请查阅相应实现的文档以获取详细信息。不过请注意，Spring 中的标准 `CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate` 实现支持此功能。

items.source: The cache statistics should be logged by invoking ContextCache.logStatistics().
items.translation: 缓存统计信息应通过调用 ContextCache.logStatistics() 进行记录。

items.source: This is intended to be invoked whenever a TestExecutionListener interacts with the application context(s) on behalf of the supplied test class.
items.translation: 这旨在在 `TestExecutionListener`接口代表提供的测试类与应用上下文交互时调用。

items.source: This informs the ContextCache that the application context(s) can be safely paused if no other test classes are actively using the same application context(s).
items.translation: 这通知 `ContextCache`，如果没有其他测试类正在使用相同的应用程序上下文，则可以安全地暂停应用程序上下文。

items.source: If the context is present in the ContextCache it will simply be returned; otherwise, it will be loaded, stored in the cache, and returned.
items.translation: 如果上下文存在于 `ContextCache` 中，则直接返回；否则，将其加载、存储到缓存中并返回。

items.source:
Generally speaking, this method should only be called if the state of
a singleton bean has been changed (potentially affecting future interaction
with the context) or if the context needs to be prematurely removed from
the cache.
items.translation: 一般来说，此方法仅在单例 Bean 的状态已更改（可能会影响与上下文的未来交互）或需要将从缓存中过早移除上下文时调用。

items.source: Remove the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration from the ContextCache and close it if it is an instance of ConfigurableApplicationContext.
items.translation: 从ContextCache中移除为提供的MergedContextConfiguration创建的application context，如果它是ConfigurableApplicationContext的实例，则调用其close()方法。

items.source: Load the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration by delegating to the ContextLoader configured in the given MergedContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 加载由给定 `MergedContextConfiguration` 中配置的 `ContextLoader` 委托加载的由提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 指定的`application context`。

items.source: Determine if the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration has been loaded (i.e., is present in the ContextCache).
items.translation: 确定已加载为提供的MergedContextConfiguration配置的application context（即，是否存在于ContextCache中）。

items.source: Register usage of the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration as well as usage of the application context for its parent, recursively.
items.translation: 注册所供应的MergedContextConfiguration对application context的使用，以及递归地注册该 application context 对其parent的使用。

items.source: Unregister usage of the application context for the supplied MergedContextConfiguration as well as usage of the application context for its parent, recursively.
items.translation: 注销为提供的MergedContextConfiguration注册的application context的使用，以及为其parent递归注册 application context 的使用。

items.source:
The default failure threshold for errors encountered while attempting to
load an application context: 1.
items.translation: 尝试加载应用程序上下文时遇到的错误的默认失败阈值：1。

items.translation: mergedConfig - 用于加载应用上下文的合并上下文配置；永远不会为 null。

items.source: mergedConfig - the merged context configuration to use to load the application context; never null
items.translation: mergedConfig - 用于加载应用上下文的合并上下文配置；永远不会为 null。

items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果在检索或加载应用程序上下文时发生错误

items.translation: mergedConfig - 应用程序上下文的合并配置；要关闭的上下文，绝不可能是 null

items.translation: hierarchyMode - 层次模式；如果上下文不属于层次结构，则可能为 null。

items.translation: key - 上下文键；永远不为 null

items.translation: true 表示应用程序上下文已加载

items.translation: 用于配置在尝试加载应用程序上下文时遇到错误的失败阈值的系统属性："spring.test.context.failure.threshold"。
